retail_store.title: Retail: store owners and managers
retail_store.intro: Five calls that make or break a store. Seal your gut answer now, before you look at the numbers. Come back when the outcome is known.

questions.prompt: For this week's promotion, will you order more, the same, or less stock than last time?
questions.outcome_prompt: Looking back, what should you have ordered?

questions.prompt: Will you need extra staff on the floor this coming weekend?
questions.outcome_prompt: Looking back, did you need extra staff?

questions.prompt: Is the stock loss on your worst line mainly theft, receiving errors, or damage and expiry?
questions.outcome_prompt: After checking, what was the main cause?

questions.prompt: Will the new product you're stocking sell through within two weeks?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did it sell through within two weeks?

questions.prompt: Will your least reliable supplier deliver in full and on time this week?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did they deliver in full and on time?

mining_operations.title: Mining: operations, engineering and safety
mining_operations.intro: Five calls every operation lives with. Seal your gut answer before you open the reports.

questions.prompt: Will your section hit this week's production target?
Will the equipment issue you're watching cause an unplanned stop within 14 days?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did it cause an unplanned stop within 14 days?

questions.prompt: Will the contractor on your current job finish this week's planned work on time?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did they finish this week's planned work on time?

questions.prompt: Which shift will log more incidents and near misses over the next two weeks?
Will your area finish the quarter under, on, or over budget?

sales.title: Sales: reps, account managers and business development
sales.intro: Five calls that decide your month. Seal your gut answer before you check the CRM.

questions.prompt: Will your biggest open deal close within the next two weeks?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did it close within two weeks?

questions.prompt: Will it close above, at, or below the price you quoted?
Will the new lead you rate highest this week agree to a next meeting within two weeks?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did they agree to a next meeting?

questions.prompt: Will you hit your monthly target?
What will be the main objection in your next pitch?

people_manager.title: Managers and team leads
people_manager.intro: Five calls about people. Seal your gut answer before you talk yourself out of it.

questions.prompt: Will the last person you hired meet the expectations you set for them this month?
Will your team's most important deliverable this week land on time?
Will the person you're most worried about show improvement within two weeks of your next conversation?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did they improve within two weeks?

questions.prompt: Will anyone on your team resign in the next three months?
In your next team meeting, will the unspoken disagreement come out in the open?

general.title: Any job: the everyday calls
general.intro: We don't have a track for your job yet, so start with the calls everyone makes. Seal your gut answer now.

questions.prompt: Will your most important task this week be finished by Friday?
Will the next estimate you give (time or cost) turn out under, on, or over?
Will the next decision you take to your boss get the answer you expect?
questions.outcome_prompt: Did you get the answer you expected?

questions.prompt: Will the meeting you're most dreading go better, as expected, or worse?
Will you reverse a decision you made this week, within the next two weeks?
